rubric_items.reason: All six acceptance criteria (column, date, doctor, Never, filter, combination with search/status/paging, no medical history, unchanged rest) map to REQ-1..REQ-14; non-asks listed under Out of scope with reasons.
Previous F-1 fixed: page size (REQ-11) and filtered total (REQ-14) are now separate. REQ-7 still leaves the time zone of 'today' and the 29 February boundary implicit.
Every known status cites the ticket, baseline, data model, conventions or an IDE answer; the one assumption (REQ-3) was confirmed in A-04; no invented values.
No ticket/baseline clash found; the undefined 'visit' and the 12-month measure were raised as questions and answered (A-01..A-03); the data-protection baseline is carried into REQ-12.
Three questions and one assumption check, each with real options and a proposed default, all answered in the IDE; none asks something the context pack already answers.
Plain wording; glossary terms Completed, Medical history and Front-desk staff used consistently; the missing 'Last visit' term is flagged.
